# Recompute liked artists and determine which are not followed yet
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='tr_solo@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Fetch all liked songs (paginated)
page_limit = 20
all_liked = []
i = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not resp:
        break
    all_liked.extend(resp)
    i += 1
print('liked_songs_total', len(all_liked))

# Extract unique artists (id->name)
artist_id_to_name = {}
for s in all_liked:
    for a in s.get('artists', []):
        artist_id_to_name[a['id']] = a['name']
artist_ids = sorted(artist_id_to_name.keys())
print('unique_artists_from_liked_songs', len(artist_ids))

# Check following status for each artist
following_status = []
for aid in artist_ids:
    st = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    following_status.append((aid, artist_id_to_name.get(aid), st.get('following')))

not_following = [t for t in following_status if not t[2]]
following_already = [t for t in following_status if t[2]]

print('following_already_count', len(following_already))
print('to_follow_count', len(not_following))
print('to_follow_ids', [t[0] for t in not_following])
print('to_follow_names', [t[1] for t in not_following])

# Follow all not-followed artists
follow_results = []
for aid, name, _ in not_following:
    r = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    follow_results.append((aid, name, r))
print('followed_count', len(follow_results))

# Verify following status after operations
verified = []
for aid, name, _ in not_following:
    st2 = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    verified.append((aid, name, st2.get('following')))

print('verified_following_true_count', sum(1 for x in verified if x[2]))
print('verified', verified)
